reading: The alert chain has three links: the alert must exist in the record, the next anaesthetist must see it before airway management (claim c2), and the plan must change so that difficulty is no longer unanticipated (claim c3). A before-after rise in recognition has been reported elsewhere (claim c1) but concurrent changes cloud it, and the database behind any local study misses events (claim c4). The untraced national figure appears only as an unverified lead.
